column1: #   Source 1: UniProt REST API — all C. reinhardtii proteins (organism_id:3055)
#   Source 2: Ensembl Plants BioMart — creinhardtii_eg_gene, Pfam attribute
#   Source 3: NCBI RefSeq GFF3 — GCF_000002595.2 (gene existence via Phytozome Dbxref)
#   DS3: Flowers et al. 2015 tpc00492 SupplementalDS3 (doi:10.5061/dryad.1n0g6)
#   Method: Merged UniProt Pfam + Ensembl BioMart Pfam + NCBI GFF3 cross-reference
#     has_pfam=1: gene has >=1 Pfam domain in UniProt and/or BioMart
#     has_pfam=0: gene found in databases but no Pfam domain annotated
#     has_pfam=-1: gene uses old JGI v5.0 ID (g####) not in v5.5/v5.6;
#                  absent from UniProt, Ensembl, and NCBI RefSeq.
#                  These 5,882 genes need hmmsearch on the v5.0 proteome (task 3).
